fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entry that is readable at night and in reduced visibility conditions.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow fire apparatus and emergency vehicles to reach the residence without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles approaching the main residence.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the sides and rear of the property to allow responders to move on foot around the structure.
• Clear a walking path around the perimeter of the residence so responders can reach the rear without forcing through overgrown areas.
• Post the location of the solar panel system's emergency shutoff on the exterior of the residence in a location visible to arriving responders.
• Mark the solar panel shutoff with a weatherproof label indicating the panel layout and shutoff location for arriving fire crews.
• Keep the perimeter fence gate nearest the detached structure unlocked or secured with a breakaway lock to allow responder access without delay.
• Mark any fence gate providing rear access with a reflective indicator so responders can locate it quickly under low-light conditions.
• Keep the area around the water feature clear so responders moving through the rear yard are not at risk of falling in during low-light operations.
• Identify the water feature

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from the large trees that extend directly over or within a few feet of the structure's roof and walls.
• Thin the tree cluster nearest the structure to create more open space between individual trees and the building.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the base of the structure.
• Clear ground vegetation growing beneath the large trees closest to the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway to keep the travel path clear for vehicles.
• Cut back shrubs and low vegetation along the driveway edges that narrow the passable width.
• Thin scattered shrubs within the immediate area around the structure so they do not connect to nearby trees or the building.
• Remove dead or dry material from ground vegetation in the areas closest to the structure.
• Keep the open green space areas mowed or cut short, particularly where they meet the mixed vegetation zones near the structure.
• Separate any shrubs or small plants that grow close enough to touch or nearly touch the larger trees nearby.
